# Rohith Illuri

> Self-taught developer. Portfolio is a single static HTML page with a dark antiquarian aesthetic — no frameworks, no build step.

## About

Rohith is a self-taught developer who likes shipping things, performance work, and clean UIs. Outside of code: heavy lifting, AC/DC at unreasonable volumes, and Tarantino films.

## Site

Deployed at https://rohithilluri.github.io — a single `site/index.html` file. Pure HTML/CSS/JS, no React, no bundler. Strict CSP (`connect-src 'none'`); everything runs offline once loaded.

Features: living-painting gallery (Wikimedia Commons), motion poster wall, orchestral background music (Tone.js generative synthesis, gesture-gated), contact section, machine-readable identity (JSON-LD Person + WebSite).

## Sections

- Part I · The Works: shipped projects
- Part II · The Craft: languages, runtimes, and platforms in daily use
- Part III · The Muses: films and music that shaped the taste
- Part IV · The Letter: how to reach him

## Projects

- CRAVE — a food-ordering marketplace (React, Node, PostgreSQL). https://github.com/rohithIlluri
- CRYPTOAPP — live crypto markets, streaming prices, breathing charts (React, WebSocket). https://github.com/rohithIlluri
- TORONTO — a city read through its open civic data (Python). https://github.com/rohithIlluri
- NNETS — neural networks from first principles, no framework (Python, Micrograd). https://github.com/rohithIlluri
